item.title: Apple Cuts Internal AI Budgets, Reducing Engineer Daily Caps by 33%
item.description:
Bloomberg reports that Apple is significantly cutting internal budgets for employee AI usage to curb rising costs. Daily token consumption caps for some engineers have dropped from $300 to $200, with plans to reduce them further to $100 or lower. This move reflects a broader industry shift from encouraging large-scale experimentation to rigorous cost-benefit analysis, mirroring similar actions by Microsoft, Tesla, and others.

原文标题：苹果收紧员工 AI 预算 部分工程师日额度降 33%

Why it matters：揭示了头部科技公司 AI 落地过程中的真实成本痛点与策略调整，对理解企业级 AI 治理具有参考价值。

item.title: OpenAI Security Model Auto-Identifies 948 Privilege Escalation Bugs in Linux Kernel
item.description:
OpenAI deployed an undisclosed next-gen security agent system that scanned ~7% of the Linux kernel in 12 hours, identifying 2,308 candidate vulnerabilities and successfully reproducing 1,724. The system generated 948 working local privilege escalation exploits, demonstrating breakthrough capabilities in automated vulnerability discovery and verification.

原文标题：OpenAI 发布安全模型 自动发现 Linux 内核千余提权漏洞

Why it matters：展示了 AI 智能体在复杂系统底层安全审计中的实际落地能力与高成功率，对开发者与安全行业具有重大警示意义。

item.title: Arm Posts Record Q2 Revenue; AGI CPU Secures Orders
item.description:
Arm reported record Q2 FY2027 revenue of $1.44 billion, up 27% YoY. While GAAP net profit fell 45% due to one-time items, non-GAAP earnings grew steadily. A key highlight is that Arm's dedicated AGI CPU has secured multiple customer orders with first commercial deliveries expected in Q4 FY2027, alongside a doubling of data center royalty revenue.

原文标题：Arm Q2 营收创纪录 AGI CPU 获订单

Why it matters：Arm 作为 AI 算力基础设施核心供应商，其专用 AI 芯片（AGI CPU）获得实质订单并明确交付时间表，标志着其在高端 AI 计算领域的商业化突破，对行业格局有重要影响。

item.title: Uber Earnings Reveal Minimal Adoption of AI Agent Bookings
item.description:
Uber's Q3 earnings reveal extremely low adoption of AI agents for ride-hailing and food delivery. During the Halloween week, out of ~320 million trips/orders, only 4 rides and 500 food orders were initiated by AI agents. CEO Dara Khosrowshahi acknowledged the traction is 'very early and limited' but noted that all major AI system companies are in talks with Uber.

原文标题：Uber 财报披露 AI 代理打车量极低

item.title: Stanford Study: NVIDIA B200 Delivers 9x Energy Efficiency vs AMD MI350X
item.description:
Stanford researchers introduced the 'Joules-to-GDP' metric to quantify the economic return of AI chips relative to energy consumption in real-world professional tasks. The study found that when running identical models, the NVIDIA B200 delivered over 4x the dollar value and 9x the expert time saved per unit of energy compared to the AMD MI350X. This highlights how hardware selection critically determines AI economic efficiency under power constraints.

原文标题：斯坦福研究：NVIDIA B200 能效比 AMD MI350X 高 9 倍

Why it matters：提供了具体的芯片能效对比数据和新颖的经济评估指标，对算力选型具有直接参考价值。

item.title: Stanford Proposes J2G Framework Showing Small Models Yield Higher Economic Value per Joule
item.description:
Stanford researchers introduced the 'Joules-to-GDP' (J2G) framework to quantify the net economic value generated per joule of energy consumed by AI tasks. Experiments on the GDPval benchmark revealed that smaller open-source models (e.g., Gemma 4 31B) deliver significantly higher economic returns per unit of energy compared to larger models, despite lower absolute output. The study highlights that scaling up hardware often yields diminishing speed gains relative to energy costs, offering new efficiency-based criteria for model selection in power-constrained environments.

原文标题：斯坦福提出 J2G 框架 揭示小模型能效经济价值更高

Why it matters：提出了量化的能效-经济价值评估新范式，数据详实，对当前高耗能大模型趋势具有直接的纠偏与指导意义。

He outlined five priorities including worker protections and data center development to address public anxiety, though OpenAI has not provided further specifics on these proposals.

item.title: Anthropic Uses Claude to Map First Bacterial Vault Particle Structure
item.description:
Anthropic's biology lab used Claude to discover and map the first 3D structure of vault particles in bacteria and their viruses. By driving the wet-lab pipeline directly, the AI reduced particle isolation from 3 days to 90 minutes and generated a preliminary structural model in just 34 hours, significantly accelerating a process that previously took weeks.

原文标题：Anthropic 用 Claude 首次解析细菌 Vault 蛋白结构

item.title: Pew Survey Reveals Deep Divide in US Public Trust of AI Healthcare
item.description:
A new Pew Research survey highlights a stark divide in American public opinion on AI in healthcare. While higher-income adults are optimistic about improved care, lower-income and younger groups fear negative outcomes. Although most accept AI for translation, only 3% would allow autonomous AI diagnosis, with widespread concerns over data privacy and the erosion of the doctor-patient relationship.

item.title: Pew Study: Majority of Americans Uncomfortable with Doctors Using AI
item.description:
A new Pew Research study reveals that 60% of Americans are uncomfortable with doctors using AI for diagnosis and treatment, with only 3% accepting fully autonomous AI diagnoses. While public acceptance exists for auxiliary uses like translation, there is deep pessimism regarding data privacy, the doctor-patient relationship, and trust in oversight, particularly among younger adults who increasingly doubt AI will improve outcomes.

原文标题：皮尤研究：多数美国人抵触医生使用 AI

Why it matters：揭示了 AI 医疗落地面临的核心社会阻力与信任危机，为行业合规与伦理设计提供关键民意数据。
